name: faxdrop-mcp
description: Enables AI assistants to send real faxes through the FaxDrop API. Provides safeguards including rate limiting, dry-run mode, and audit logging for secure fax operations.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to send real faxes through the FaxDrop API. Provides safeguards including rate limiting, dry-run mode, and audit logging for secure fax operations.

FAXDROP_API_KEY.description: Your FaxDrop API key, obtained from faxdrop.com/account (Developer API → Generate Key). Keys look like 'fd_live_<32 hex>'.

FAXDROP_MCP_DRY_RUN.description: Enable dry run mode to simulate sending without calling FaxDrop. Set to 'true' to enable. Default is off.

FAXDROP_MCP_AUDIT_LOG.description: Path to an audit log file for append-only JSON Lines logging. Sensitive args are redacted. Default is off.

FAXDROP_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_send.description: Daily rate limit for sending faxes, e.g., '100/day'. Use 'N/minute', 'N/hour', 'N/day', or 'N/week'. Default is '100/day'.

FAXDROP_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLE.description: Disable rate limit for testing. Set to 'true' to turn off. Default is off.
